title: App closes on launch after updating to v3.0
description: Since this morning's update, every tenant on Android 13 sees the splash screen and then the app closes. iOS is fine. Android tenants cannot pay rent or message their landlords.

title: Rent reminders arrive at 3am
description: Since last week tenants get their rent reminder push notification at 3am instead of 9am. The reminder text and amounts are correct.

title: Sinhala language option
description: Many of our older tenants would prefer to use the app in Sinhala. Could you add it?

title: How does a tenant change the phone number they log in with?
description: A tenant got a new SIM card. They log in with a one-time code sent to their phone number. How do they move their account to the new number?

title: Property photos appear rotated sideways
description: Photos taken in portrait on some Samsung phones show up rotated by 90 degrees in the listing. Landscape photos are fine.

title: Payments screen shows another tenant's name
description: A tenant opened the payments screen and saw another tenant's name and unit number at the top. She says she did not see any payment amounts.

title: Map is laggy on older phones
description: Scrolling the map with many listings is very laggy on phones that are about four years old. Newer phones are smooth, and the list view works on all phones.

title: App and web portal both down
description: Since 10:15 the app shows 'Cannot reach server' and the landlord web portal shows a 502 Bad Gateway page, for everyone we have asked.

title: Chat messages show in the wrong order
description: In some conversations, newer messages appear above older ones after the app has been in the background. Reopening the chat fixes the order.

title: Maintenance requests submitted twice
description: When a tenant taps Submit on a maintenance request with a weak connection, the request is often created twice and the landlord gets two notifications.

title: Can landlords see when a tenant has read a message?
description: One of our landlords asked whether the app shows read receipts for messages they send to tenants.

title: Face ID login stopped working on iOS 18
description: Since tenants updated to iOS 18, Face ID login fails and they have to type their password. The password login works.

title: Lease PDF opens as a blank page in the app
description: Tapping 'View lease' opens a blank white page on Android. The same lease downloads fine from the web portal.

title: Let tenants pay rent with Apple Pay
description: Our tenants keep asking for Apple Pay at checkout. Card payments work today.

title: Battery drain from location tracking
description: Several tenants report the app uses 20-30% of their battery a day even when they don't open it. Settings shows constant background location use.

title: Monthly income report shows the wrong totals
description: The landlord income report for September shows totals about 8% higher than the sum of the individual payments listed below it.

title: Date picker hidden behind the footer
description: On the lease form, the move-in date picker opens behind the page footer on small laptop screens, so the last row of dates can't be clicked. Typing the date works.

title: Card payments failing for all tenants
description: Since about 14:00 every card payment fails with 'Payment declined by gateway'. Bank transfers work. Rent is due tomorrow.

title: Landlords logged out every few minutes
description: Landlords using the web portal are logged out every 3-5 minutes while working, losing unsaved forms. This started after yesterday's release.

title: Export payments to Excel
description: We would like to download the payments table as an Excel file for our accountant. Copying from the screen works for now.

title: Bulk tenant import creates duplicates
description: Importing a CSV of tenants twice creates every tenant twice, with duplicate leases and invoices. We now have about 300 duplicate tenants.

title: How do I add a second administrator to our account?
description: Our office manager also needs admin access to the landlord portal. How can I give it to her?

title: Dashboard takes 40 seconds to load
description: For landlords with more than 200 units, the dashboard takes 30-40 seconds to load. Smaller accounts load in a couple of seconds.

title: Invoice emails not sent since Monday
description: Tenants have not received any invoice emails since Monday. Invoices are created and visible in the portal.

title: Typo on the sign-up page
description: The sign-up page says 'Create you account' instead of 'Create your account'.

title: Uploaded lease scans show as corrupted
description: Lease scans uploaded as PDF from the web portal download as corrupted files that won't open. Older uploads are fine; this started this week.

title: Unit filter resets when changing page
description: On the units list, the 'Vacant only' filter is lost when moving to page 2 of the results.

title: SSL certificate warning on the portal
description: Browsers show 'Your connection is not private' on the landlord portal since this morning. Some landlords clicked through, most can't get in.

title: Show late fees separately on invoices
description: Landlords would like late fees shown as a separate line instead of being added to the rent amount.

title: Opposing counsel can see our internal notes
description: Opposing counsel told us they can see our internal case notes in the shared case room. Those notes should only be visible to our firm.

title: Court deadline reminders not sent
description: No deadline reminder emails have been sent this week. We have three filings due on Friday.

title: Korean characters garbled in exported briefs
description: When we export a brief to Word, Korean text becomes question marks. The text displays correctly in the editor.

title: Is there a limit on case documents?
description: Before we import our archive, is there a maximum number of documents per case?

title: Billable hours report double-counts split entries
description: When a time entry is split between two cases, the billable hours report counts the full hours on both cases. Our invoices to clients were overstated.

title: Search results slow for large firms
description: Document search takes 20-30 seconds for our firm since we passed 100,000 documents. It used to take under a second.

title: Case calendar shows hearings one hour off
description: Since daylight saving time ended, hearings in the case calendar show one hour later than the time we entered for our New York cases.

title: Outlook calendar sync for hearings
description: We would like hearing dates to appear in our Outlook calendars automatically.

title: E-signature request emails go to spam
description: Signature request emails sent to clients land in their spam folders, mostly for Gmail recipients. Clients don't see them for days.

title: Sidebar overlaps the document viewer on tablets
description: On iPads in portrait mode, the left sidebar covers part of the document viewer and can't be closed.

title: How do I restore a deleted document?
description: An associate deleted a draft contract by mistake yesterday. Can we get it back?

title: Uploads of large evidence videos fail
description: Video evidence files over 2 GB fail at 99% with 'Upload failed'. Smaller files upload normally.

title: New users never receive their invitation email
description: We invited four new associates yesterday and none of them received the invitation email. Resending did not help.

title: Conflict check misses parties with accented names
description: The conflict check did not find an existing client named 'José Álvarez' when we searched for 'Jose Alvarez'. We nearly took on a conflicting matter.

title: All pipeline jobs stuck in queued
description: No pipeline job has started since 02:00. About 60 jobs are queued, including samples with clinical deadlines today.

title: Variant caller reports wrong allele frequencies
description: Allele frequencies in the VCF output are consistently about half the values we see in IGV for the same positions since pipeline v4.2.

title: Pipeline fails on paired-end files with spaces in names
description: Runs fail at the alignment step when FASTQ file names contain spaces. Renaming the files works around it.

title: Which reference genome builds are supported?
description: We are starting a new project. Does the pipeline support GRCh38 and T2T-CHM13?

title: QC report missing coverage plots
description: The QC report for the last two batches has the coverage section but no plots. The numbers are there.

title: Support for long-read RNA data
description: We would like to run long-read RNA-seq data through the expression pipeline.

title: Sample metadata lost after re-ingestion
description: We re-ingested a batch to fix one barcode and all the sample metadata (tissue, donor age) for that batch was wiped.

title: Jobs much slower since Tuesday
description: The standard exome pipeline used to finish in about 3 hours and now takes 9-10 hours. Nothing changed on our side.

title: S3 import fails with access denied
description: Importing data from our S3 bucket fails with AccessDenied since we rotated our AWS keys and updated them in settings.

title: Pipeline results visible to another customer
description: A collaborator from a different organisation says they can see one of our project names and sample IDs in their project list.

title: Job completion emails delayed by hours
description: Job completion emails arrive 3-6 hours after jobs finish. The results are available on time.

title: Pipeline crashes on samples with zero reads
description: If a sample in a batch has zero reads, the whole batch fails instead of skipping that sample.

title: How long are raw files kept?
description: How long do you keep our raw FASTQ files after a run, and can we change it?

title: Disk full errors during large batches
description: Large batches fail with 'No space left on device' at the sorting step. Small batches work.

title: Charts blank in Safari
description: The coverage and variant charts are blank in Safari 17. Chrome and Firefox show them.

title: Dashboard numbers don't match the downloaded results
description: The dashboard says 1,204 variants passed filters for sample S-88, but the downloaded VCF has 1,187.

title: Dark mode for the dashboard
description: A dark theme would be nice for working in the lab at night.

title: SSO login loops back to the login page
description: Since this morning, everyone who signs in with our company SSO is sent back to the login page. Nobody in our organisation can access results.

title: Can we share a report with someone outside our organisation?
description: Our clinical partner needs to see one report. Can we share it without creating an account for them?

title: CSV download missing the last rows
description: Downloading the sample table as CSV drops the last few rows when there are more than 1,000 samples.

title: Table columns misaligned when zoomed
description: At 125% browser zoom the column headers of the variant table no longer line up with the data.

title: Dashboard very slow for large projects
description: Opening a project with more than 5,000 samples takes over a minute and sometimes times out.

title: Report PDF shows the wrong project name
description: Every PDF report we generated today has the name of our previous project in the header, although the data is from the right project.

title: Slack notifications when a run finishes
description: We would like a message in our Slack channel when a pipeline run completes.

title: Error page when opening an archived project
description: Opening any archived project shows 'Something went wrong' with error code 500. Active projects open fine.

title: Password reset link expired immediately
description: A researcher clicked the password reset link within a minute of receiving it and got 'Link expired'. Another researcher had the same problem.

title: Where can I see how much storage we are using?
description: Our finance team wants to know how much storage our organisation is using. Is that shown anywhere?
